cardSummary: Learn how trends, key levels, and session liquidity shape the conditions around a trade before risk is placed.

disclosures.title: Educational Content Only
disclosures.body: For educational and informational purposes only. This material is not investment advice or a recommendation. Trading and investing involve risk, including possible loss of principal.

lessons.title: 2.1 Defining the Trend
lessons.summary: Beginners often use the word "trend" to mean "price moved fast."

lessons.title: 2.2 Support, Resistance, and Key Levels
lessons.summary: Many beginners fill a chart with lines and then expect every line to act like a wall.

lessons.title: 2.3 Session Overlaps and Liquidity
lessons.summary: Markets are global, but market activity is not evenly spread across every hour of the day.
